facts.claim: Subscription revenue grew 105% year on year in the first quarter of 2026, against 29% for in-app purchases and 14% for advertising

facts.excerpt: Subscription revenue grew 105% year over year in Q1 2026, against 29% for in-app purchases and 14% for ad revenue.

facts.claim: Subscriptions account for 82% of the revenue non-gaming apps earn on the app stores
facts.source_title: Top 12 ways to monetize your app in 2026
facts.excerpt: 82% of the revenue non-gaming apps make on the app stores comes from subscriptions.

facts.claim: Among 686 tracked apps, subscriptions are the primary model for 418, or 61%, against advertising for 176, or 26%
facts.source_title: How do tracked apps actually make money?
facts.excerpt: Among tracked apps, subscriptions account for 418 of 686 apps (61%), more than double advertising at 176/686 (26%).

facts.claim: Google Play's 2026 standard rate is 10% on the first 1 million dollars of annual revenue and 20% above it
facts.source_title: Google Play External Payments and Fee Changes
facts.excerpt: Google lowered its baseline: the standard rate is now 10% on the first $1 million and 20% above it, plus a billing fee charged separately.
